description: Background images for VS Code: full window or per part, with folders, rotation and live updates. Successor to BackImage.
config.enabled: Show background images. Turning this on for the first time installs UshiroE's patch into VS Code and asks you to restart VS Code.
config.mode.fullscreen: One image over the whole window.
config.mode.parts: Separate images for the editor, side bars and panel.
config.sources: Images that areas can use: a file, a folder (rotates through its images) or an `http(s)://` URL. UshiroE copies every image into its image folder (`#ushiroe.libraryFolder#`) and shows the copies. Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, SVG and WebP.
config.source.id: Unique id that areas refer to.
config.source.name: Display name.
config.source.path: File path, folder path or URL of the original image.
config.source.random: Show the folder's images in random order.
config.source.interval: Seconds between images for folders. 0 keeps one image.
config.fullscreen: Background for the whole window, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `fullscreen`.
config.editor: Background for the editor area, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.sidebar: Background for the primary side bar, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.auxiliaryBar: Background for the secondary side bar, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.panel: Background for the panel, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.area.enabled: Draw a background in this part.
config.area.source: Id of the image source to show, or `*` for all images in random order.
config.area.opacity: How visible the image is, from 0 to 1.
config.area.size: How the image fits the area.
config.area.position: CSS background-position, such as `center` or `right bottom`.
config.transition: Seconds the cross-fade between rotating images takes.
config.patch.hideCorruptWarning: Update VS Code's checksum for the patched file so that VS Code does not report the installation as corrupt.
config.patch.autoRepair: Re-apply the patch automatically when VS Code was updated and the patch is gone.
command.refreshImages: Copy and Download All Images Again
command.refreshSource: Copy or Download This Image Again
config.source.refresh.never: Once, when the source is added. Use Download Again to update it.
config.source.refresh.startup: Again at every startup, so changes at the URL show up.
config.shuffleInterval: Seconds between images when an area shows all images (`*`). 0 changes the image only at startup.
config.presets: Saved layouts: the mode and every area's settings. Manage them from the UshiroE view.
config.randomPresetOnStartup: Apply a random preset each time VS Code starts.
config.libraryFolder: Folder UshiroE copies images into. Leave empty to use `UshiroE` in your Pictures folder. Changing it copies the images again; the old folder is kept.
